approval_controls.automatic_review_behavior_from_help: Routes approval requests through automatic review using the workspace-write sandbox.

exit_code_behavior.runner_behavior: operator.sh uses shell exec, so the runner process is replaced by codex exec and propagates its process exit status without masking it.

nested_shell_invocation.evidence: The installed codex executable and codex exec help were invoked successfully from a shell process.
nested_shell_invocation.reason_not_tested: The structured request explicitly forbids executing the new runner against bridge-phase7-001.

bridge_cli_enhancement.behavior: Each command requires exactly one pending request, loads and validates the v0.3 request JSON, and emits only the requested machine-readable scalar.
bridge_cli_enhancement.protocol_compatibility: Existing v0.3 status, next, validate-request, branch, and verify-report behavior is retained.

runner_contract: Operate from the repository root regardless of the caller's current directory.
Require git, python3, and codex executables.
Require the current branch to be main.
Refuse tracked staged or unstaged changes.
Refuse untracked non-ignored files to avoid accidental inclusion or overwrite.
Fetch origin/main and use git pull --ff-only origin main.
Require exactly one pending validated structured request.
Derive task_id and operator_branch through bridge_cli.py JSON-backed scalar commands.
Refuse an existing local or remote task branch before invoking Codex.
Launch codex exec non-interactively with a fixed bootstrap instruction that identifies the authoritative request JSON.
Replace the shell with codex exec so its exit status is propagated.
safety_guards: No force-push command exists in operator.sh.
No merge command exists in operator.sh.
No Rhino/MCP runtime module is imported or modified by operator.sh or the bridge CLI enhancement.
The dangerous Codex approval/sandbox bypass flag is not used.
The fixed bootstrap instructs Codex not to force-push, merge, discard local work, or use another repository unless the request explicitly authorizes it.
Existing local or remote operator branches cause refusal rather than overwrite.
Multiple or zero pending requests cause refusal rather than ambiguous execution.
limitations: The runner was not executed against bridge-phase7-001 because this is the builder task and the request prohibits doing so.
Codex help does not document a numeric exit-code map; the runner preserves whatever process status codex exec returns.
Successful end-to-end approval review, Git push, and task completion must be validated by the separate controller test after merge.
Automatic approval review may still deny an unsafe action; the agent must then report the concrete blocker rather than bypass safeguards.
